target_state: implemented staging handoff. The worker target 0x00e3a400 is an INTERIOR address of the Ghidra body FUN_00e3a270: it is the second byte of the ten-byte instruction at 0x00e3a40a (8B 40 0C  MOV EAX,[EAX+0xc]), the fourth of the four stores of the 0x00e3a3e2 arm. The queue names the record 'Simulator' and counts 172 instructions, and 172 is the length of the WHOLE body 0x00e3a270..0x00e3a56a, so this package reconstructs all 172 instructions of that body and names the symbol with the target VA as the validator requires. The committed Ghidra record is NOT truncated: body_start 0x00e3a270, body_end 0x00e3a56a, size_bytes 763, 172 instructions, and an independent re-derivation from the image reproduces it instruction for instruction at the same addresses with the same lengths.

implementation.declaration: extern "C" Word SW2_00E3A400_THISCALL re_00e3a400(Simulator* receiver, Word selector, const PropertyRecord* record)
implementation.argument_surface: receiver in ECX, dereferenced at nineteen distinct displacements and never written through any other base; exactly TWO ordinary stack arguments, a 32-bit selector at entry_ESP+0x4 (read once, at 0x00e3a270) and a record pointer at entry_ESP+0x8 (read at ten sites). The body performs no PUSH other than the three argument pushes before its three calls, no POP, no SUB ESP and no frame setup, and the machine parse reports local_extent 0 with esp_unresolved false, so those two slots are the only stack words it can name. Thirteen terminators, all C2 08 00 = RET 0x8, so the callee owns the eight bytes of cleanup.
implementation.return_type_note: Word, i.e. a four-byte value in EAX. The machine envelope names EAX as the return register (return_register EAX, inference RT1), classifies its content aggregate_unknown / unclassified_in_EAX, and states void_possible false. Declaring void would contradict the envelope; declaring anything narrower would contradict the 32-bit transfer. The CONTENT is path-dependent in four different ways and the reconstruction reproduces it per path because the listing fixes it: the three calling arms forward the callee's result, the two vector arms leave the value-block pointer, the tag and lazy arms leave the block's first word, and a selector that matches no case leaves the selector itself. No claim is made that the value means anything: the only caller in the binary, FUN_00e3f970 at 0x00e3fc73, does not read EAX after its call.
implementation.receiver_model: an opaque 0x330-byte run with NO members. The machine-derived receiver record (abi_derived.value.receiver) is bounds_only TRUE, names ECX with shape R-DIRECT, max_offset 804, written_through 1 and enumerates the single displacement 0x324 -- a lower bound derived from two observations (obs-0008 at 0x00e3a2ca and obs-0009 at 0x00e3a2d0) which the complete listing contradicts by showing sixteen under that register. Because bounds_only is true it cannot refute a declared member, and no machine record anywhere in this repository names a member at any displacement, so this package declares no member and reaches the receiver through displacement-named accessors (word_at / pointer_at). 0x32c is the largest displacement and every access there is a dword, so 0x330 is the last byte the body can touch and the modeled object is exactly that size.
implementation.dispatch_model: a SIGNED binary search tree over the selector, reproduced as nested if/else-if with every ordering compare spelled signed_greater(). Seven JG branches (0x0F 8F at 0x00e3a279, a28a, a297, a3a8, a3b9 and 0x7F at a33c, a4c3) split on seven pivots; 0xf278934a is the root. Fifteen of the twenty-seven selector values have the high bit set and are negative signed, twelve are positive. A C++ > on a std::uint32_t is UNSIGNED, and the two readings agree only where both operands share the sign bit: the root pivot is negative, so the fifteen negative selectors route identically either way and the twelve POSITIVE selectors do not -- unsigned they fall below the root into the low half, whose seven leaf tests are all negative values, so twelve arms become unreachable. abi_derived.dispatch records indirect_calls 0, call_offsets [] and vtable_shaped_loads 0, and no instruction of the 172 is a register- or memory-operand transfer, so NO slot boundary and no virtual dispatch is declared anywhere in this package; the body never reads the receiver's +0x00 either.
implementation.dependency_note: the one direct callee, 0x00e39420, is declared extern in the package header and defined as an observer in the package's own model test, which is how the test sees the transfer, its three arguments in push order, the receiver's state at the instant of the call, and the callee's own return value. The model test defines no other external symbol and the reconstruction depends on nothing outside the three staging files.

observed_mechanics: the body is 172 instructions, 0x00e3a270..0x00e3a56a inclusive, 763 bytes, and every one of the 172 is accounted for by this reconstruction: 64 MOV, 34 CMP, 23 JZ, 13 RET, 12 JNZ, 9 PUSH, 7 JG, 6 ADD, 3 CALL and 1 TEST.
the selector is read once, at 0x00e3a270, from entry_ESP+0x4, and is compared against exactly twenty-seven CMP EAX,<imm32> immediates and nothing else in the dispatch.
the dispatch is a SIGNED binary search tree: all seven ordering branches are JG (0x0F 8F and 0x7F), never JA or JAE, and there is no unsigned compare anywhere in the body.

fifteen of the twenty-seven selector values have the high bit set (0x8133fb2e, 0x980e43f2, 0x99f0d1da, 0x9f792b4c, 0xa0973374, 0xa6cb4c9f, 0xaaf6aaac, 0xade76cce, 0xcdb3696f, 0xd536c91d, 0xd832b059, 0xdca976d0, 0xe0bc9d45, 0xf278934a, 0xf967827c) and twelve are positive.

there are ten distinct arm blocks. Six are reached from more than one branch, which is why the model shares them as lambdas instead of duplicating them: 0x00e3a2c0 from four branches, 0x00e3a517 from ten, 0x00e3a3e2 from three, 0x00e3a4e4 from three, 0x00e3a546 from three, and the four single-reacher arms 0x00e3a364, a419, a468, a4a1.

five of the twenty-seven selectors are reached ONLY by a fall-through after a CMP/JNZ: 0x99f0d1da (after 0x00e3a2ba), 0x25ca9233 (after 0x00e3a3dc), 0x6a9f2620 (after 0x00e3a4de), 0x7bceaa86 (after 0x00e3a515) and 0x3b38f92a (after 0x00e3a462).

the receiver is ECX. Nineteen distinct displacements are involved: sixteen appear as memory operands under it and account for 23 store instructions between them, and three more (0x29c, 0x2b4, 0x2c0) are produced by ADD ECX,<disp> and pushed, so the listing shows no memory operand under them at all.
the largest displacement is 0x32c and every access there is a dword, so 0x330 is the last byte this body can touch.

the second ordinary argument is a POINTER and exactly one word of it is ever read, at +0x0c. That word is itself a POINTER: every value the body stores is read through it, at +0x08, +0x0c, +0x10 and +0x14. Two levels of indirection, never one, and never a member of the record itself.
the same +0x0c is read by the one direct callee, 0x00e39420, at 0x00e39428, which corroborates the record's shape from outside this body.
three call sites, all to 0x00e39420, all with the identical argument shape (record, 0x3, self+0x2c0 / self+0x2b4 / self+0x29c) and all followed by ADD ESP,0xc.
the callee is cdecl: its terminator is a bare C3 at 0x00e3944e, and this body performs the cleanup itself at all three sites.

the callee's 47 bytes rotate the three words it copies: destination +0x4 from q[index+0], destination +0x0 from q[index+1], destination +0x08 from q[index+2], with index 3. The receiver's three 12-byte destinations therefore cannot be described as a plain copy, and the rotation is reproduced in the test's observer.

the callee's last write to EAX is MOV EAX,[EAX+0xc] at 0x00e39443, so it returns the record's +0x0c word, and this body FORWARDS it: ADD ESP,0xc and RET 0x8 are all that follow each call, with no intervening write to EAX.

the tag guard is a comparison against -1, CMP DWORD PTR [ECX+0x32c],0xffffffff, so a receiver word holding 0 is LEFT ALONE by a guarded arm. Four tag stores are guarded and one, 0x1654c00 at 0x00e3a4a5, is not.
five of the six consecutive values 0x1654c00..0x1654c05 are stored into the single receiver word at +0x32c; 0x1654c03 never appears in the body.

in the three lazy arms the primary store is CONDITIONAL and the secondary store is UNCONDITIONAL, even though the CMP precedes both: the compare is at 0x00e3a2f8 / a42c / a47b and the JNZ that acts on it is at 0x00e3a30f / a443 / a492, AFTER the secondary store at 0x00e3a309 / a43d / a48c. The MOVs in between do not touch the flags.
the body's only null test is TEST EAX,EAX / JZ at 0x00e3a51b / a51d, inside the single arm that ten selectors reach; the other nine arms dereference the record unconditionally.

one arm writes four destinations and its source order is NOT ascending: q[+0x08] -> +0x314, q[+0x0c] -> +0x2ac, q[+0x10] -> +0x2a8, q[+0x14] -> +0x2b0, so the middle pair is swapped. The three-write arm at 0x00e3a517 writes the same three block words in ASCENDING order to +0x2d0, +0x2cc and +0x2d4. The two arms therefore disagree about order and neither is the other's typo.

the only caller of the body in the whole binary is FUN_00e3f970 at 0x00e3fc73, which the xref export's single incoming row names independently. That caller pushes the second argument from the result of a call at 0x00e3fc66 and the first from a stack slot, sets ECX from its own EBP, and does NOT read EAX after the call.
there is no indirect transfer, no loop, no stack frame, no SEH cookie and no data-segment address in the 172 instructions; abi_derived.dispatch agrees at indirect_calls 0.

observed_original_abi.return_note: the two are not in conflict about a fact; they are in conflict about a vocabulary. abi_derived.value.abi names EAX as the return register and states void_possible false, which the declaration of a four-byte return agrees with. Its return_semantics token, unclassified_in_EAX, is a machine-vocabulary PHRASE describing the register's content as unclassified, not a C type, so validate's string-comparison arm compares Word with unclassified_in_EAX and WARNs no matter what is declared. The alternatives were weighed: declaring void would contradict void_possible false and the paths that demonstrably write EAX; declaring a typedef named after the phrase would be a validator hack. So the honest reading is declared and the disagreement is recorded here and in known_blockers. The .cpp reproduces EAX's content per path because the listing fixes it exactly, and no claim is made that the content means anything.

mechanics.body_shape: a twenty-seven-way hashed-property dispatcher: match a 32-bit selector against twenty-seven hashed ids through a signed binary search tree, then write words read out of the record's value block into nineteen receiver displacements, and for nine of the selectors also hand the record to one helper together with the constant 3 and a computed receiver address.
mechanics.frame_resolution: no frame. The 172 instructions contain no PUSH other than the three argument pushes before the three calls, no POP, no SUB ESP and no MOV EBP,ESP, which is why the machine parse reports local_extent 0 with esp_unresolved false, why the two entry-relative slots at +0x4 and +0x8 are the only stack words the body can name, and why [ESP+0x4] and [ESP+0x8] are read directly rather than through a frame pointer.

receiver_displacement.note: the three computed destinations are write-only as far as this body is concerned: the listing shows no memory operand under them and the callee is what fills them

key_record_displacements.+0x0c: a POINTER, the only word of the record this body reads, at ten sites

value_block_displacements.+0x00..+0x07: never read by this body or by its callee
value_block_displacements.+0x08: read by six of the ten arms
value_block_displacements.+0x0c: read by two arms and by the callee
value_block_displacements.+0x10: read by two arms and by the callee

mechanics.layout_derivation: 0x330 = 0x32c + 4. It is the smallest size consistent with this body's own accesses and is a lower bound, not a measurement. The only caller passes its own EBP as the receiver, so the real object is at least as large as whatever EBP points at; nothing here bounds it above.
mechanics.control_flow: forty-two conditional branches (twenty-three JZ, twelve JNZ, seven JG) and thirteen terminators; every one of the forty-two targets lies inside the recovered body span 0x00e3a270..0x00e3a56a, so the branch graph closes inside it. Ten of the JNZ/JE default edges and the five fall-through edges target 0x00e3a568, the shared default return.
mechanics.dispatch_structure: a binary search tree, not a chain. The root pivot is 0xf278934a; the high half is pivoted on 0x3e2a3040, then 0x6cd9ec7b and 0x279c4e55; the low half is pivoted on 0xaaf6aaac, then 0x9f792b4c and 0xd832b059. Four pivots have the high bit set and three do not, and the three that do not are where a signed and an unsigned reading part company.
mechanics.miss_path: every miss reaches 0x00e3a568 and returns having written nothing and called nothing: ten JNZ/JE default edges from the dispatch, plus a null record on the one guarded arm, plus a non-zero primary in the three lazy arms (which still store the secondary and the tag first).
mechanics.not_modelled: no virtual dispatch, no vtable, no slot boundary and no member at the receiver's +0x00 -- the body contains no indirect transfer and never reads +0x00, so declaring any of them would be a claim the machine does not make. No class name: SporeApp.exe carries no MSVC RTTI, no persisted symbol names this address and no record in this repository associates a type with it, so the type is called Simulator for readability and nothing else.
mechanics.globals: none. The complete 172-instruction listing names no data-segment address. The five immediates 0x1654c00..0x1654c05 fall inside the validator's crude 0x1300000..0x02000000 data-address range even though they are immediate operands and not addresses, and the source span reproduces all five, which is what fixes the GLOBALS verdict at WARN. The values are reproduced because reproducing them IS the body, and dropping them to chase the check would be a falsification.

direct_call_3.eax_after: the callee's result, forwarded; this site falls through into the body's shared default return at 0x00e3a568

mechanics.return_semantics_machine: abi_derived.return names EAX, register_class aggregate_unknown, type null, void_possible false, bulk_write false; abi_derived.return_semantics is unclassified_in_EAX; inference RT1 (INFERRED) says the return value is carried in EAX and RT2 says the last value written to it classifies as aggregate_unknown. sret.present is false, and the one place that could refute it -- whether EAX holds the entry slot 0 pointer at a return -- is recorded as null, i.e. unmeasured.
mechanics.receiver_writes: 23 store instructions over sixteen displacements; five of them (all at +0x32c) are guarded by a comparison against -1, and three of them (the 'primary' words at 0x314, 0x31c and 0x324) are guarded by a comparison against zero that is acted on FOUR INSTRUCTIONS LATER than the store it guards.

return_semantics.kind: four bytes in EAX, content unclassified by the machine
return_semantics.value: a four-byte value in EAX. Its content is path-dependent and the reconstruction reproduces it per path because the listing fixes it: on the three calling arms it is the callee's own result, on the two vector arms (0x00e3a3e2 and 0x00e3a517) it is the value-block pointer left by the last MOV EAX,[EAX+0xc], on the five tag/lazy arms it is the block's first word, and on every path that matches no case it is the selector itself, untouched since 0x00e3a270.
return_semantics.ownership: the body acquires and releases nothing. It reads the caller's record by pointer, hands the same pointer to one callee, and keeps no reference to anything after returning. The value it returns is a copy of a word it read, a pointer it already had, or a value the callee produced; nothing is owned.
return_semantics.lifetime: the record and its value block belong to the caller and outlive the call. The value block the body reads is the one the caller passed, and the only mutation the reconstruction's own test provokes is the observer poisoning word_08 at call time to prove the read happened before the call.

unresolved_questions: CALLS: the xref export is keyed by function entry and 0x00e3a400 is an interior address, so the export has no row for it and validate's source-vs-xref arm reports FAIL against the one address-named callee in the span. The call is real and is corroborated three ways: by the listing (CALL 0x00e39420 at 0x00e3a2da, a4fe, a560), by the export's three rows for the containing function's entry 0x00e3a270 at exactly those callsites, and by the callee's own 47 bytes. The FAIL is a property of the target address. Reported, not worked around: naming the callee without the address suffix would only move the FAIL to the machine-vs-machine arm, and omitting the call would falsify the body.

What the twenty-seven selector values are hashes OF. They are the immediates of twenty-seven CMP EAX,<imm32> and nothing in this repository inverts any of them, so no arm is named for a property and no preimage is claimed.

What the nineteen receiver displacements MEAN. Three of them (0x29c, 0x2b4, 0x2c0) are 12-byte destinations a helper fills; 0x2a8/0x2ac/0x2b0 and 0x2cc/0x2d0/0x2d4 are triples each written by one arm; 0x314/0x318, 0x31c/0x320 and 0x324/0x328 are pairs one of whose members is written only while the other is zero; and 0x32c takes five of the six consecutive values 0x1654c00..0x1654c05. NONE of that is named as a field, because the machine-derived receiver record is bounds_only and no machine record anywhere in this repository names a member at any displacement.

What the six tag immediates 0x1654c00..0x1654c05 denote, and why 0x1654c03 never appears. The guard (CMP [ECX+0x32c],-1 / JNZ skip) and the values are reproduced exactly; the meaning is not claimed. Note also that 0x1654c00 is the one tag written UNCONDITIONALLY, and it is written by the arm that also stores 0x308 -- an asymmetry that is reproduced and not explained.

Whether the three lazy pairs really are one quantity each, or three unrelated coincidences of adjacency. The secondary store is unconditional and the primary is conditional in all three, and the primary of one pair (0x31c) is written unconditionally by a different arm, which is what a defaulting-eager-setter pair would look like -- but the byte listing does not prove the pairing and no other evidence here does either. LABELLED INFERRED, not asserted.

The meaning of the value the body returns. The machine classifies EAX's content as aggregate_unknown, the body writes it four different ways, and the only caller in the binary does not read it. validation.model_test: a plain int main() with explicit checks, no framework and no external dependency. The one direct callee is defined in the test as an observer, so the test sees every transfer, its three arguments BY IDENTITY rather than by signature position, the receiver's state at the instant of the call, and a poison return value. The oracle is a 27-row hand-written selector-to-arm table read off the listing, never the model's own dispatch, so a self-consistent but wrong tree still fails. The effect of every case is measured by diffing a 0x340-byte probe (the 0x330-byte modeled object plus a 0x10-byte canary) against a per-byte pattern, so a wrong displacement, a swapped pair, an extra store, a store of the wrong width and a write past the end of the object are all visible. Eleven refutation families are driven: A signed-vs-unsigned dispatch (the test first proves the two readings differ for twelve selectors, so the case is not vacuous), B branch polarity at all 54 neighbours of all 27 selectors, C off-by-one displacements in the receiver and in the value block, D wrong pointer level (decoys in the record, a second block the record does not point at, and a planted value in the block's unread head), E wrong receiver (the destination is checked by identity and the canary must be untouched), F wrong callee argument order, G wrong write ordering (the observer snapshots the receiver, and poisons the block's first word so a read-after-call reconstruction is caught), H wrong constant (the tag guard is driven with -1, with 0, with another tag and with 1, and the copy index must be 3), I a missing arm or a dropped fall-through, J an extra match (eighty-six non-selector values including a deterministic pseudo-random sweep), plus the per-path return-register content and a measured ESP across the call.
